biological_meaning: Concentration producing half-maximal inhibition under a specified assay
limitation: Depends on substrate, enzyme system and incubation; not interchangeable with Ki

biological_meaning: Concentration giving half of the fitted assay response
limitation: Not automatically identical to IC50 or Kd

biological_meaning: Effect at a fixed tested concentration
limitation: Not a concentration or pIC50; interpretation needs assay sign convention

biological_meaning: qHTS response at the top concentration
limitation: Activity amplitude rather than potency; source includes inactive curves
Do not convert blindly to percent inhibition or pIC50

biological_meaning: Potency measured under TDI assay conditions
limitation: One preincubation flag does not itself establish time-dependent inactivation

units: Undocumented; numerical agreement with existing log potency
limitation: No verified units, aggregation rule, original assay IDs or protocol

units: Upper bound label in supplied y coordinates
biological_meaning: A limit rather than an exact value
limitation: If y is pIC50, y<5 would mean IC50>10 micromolar; direction/conversion requires confirmation

biological_meaning: Possible indicator of preincubation in source metadata
limitation: Not a measured TDI class, kinact or KI
Do not equate with SD, credible interval or assay error without definition
